sources.title: Andy Robson's £1,000,000 Premier League Predictor Game 26/27

prize.text: £1,000,000 only for a perfect 1-20 table prediction, split between all perfect entries; realistic prizes are £500 / £250 / £100 cash for the closest predictions
prize.quote: 1st place wins £500 cash, 2nd place £250, and 3rd place £100. ... A perfect prediction wins £1,000,000.

freeEntry.quote: Whoever tops the leaderboard will win £500 cash, 2nd will receive £250 cash and third £100 cash and it's completely free to enter.

deadline.text: Entry closed 2026-09-18 at 12:00 BST for the 26/27 season
deadline.quote: The deadline to enter (or edit your predictions) is Friday 18th September at 12:00BST.

eligibility.text: 18+; the £1,000,000 jackpot is limited to UK or Ireland residents, and entries from outside the UK and Ireland are not eligible
eligibility.quote: The £1,000,000 jackpot can only be won by a UK or Ireland resident. ... Entries from outside the UK and Ireland are not currently eligible.

payout.quote: Payment method not described; prizes must be claimed within 30 days.

summary: Two problems: entry closed on 2026-09-18 for the 26/27 season, and the headline £1,000,000 is a lottery-style perfect-table jackpot on a betting-tipster site limited to UK/Ireland residents - not a US-eligible cash opportunity.
flags: Entry closed 2026-09-18; upstream listed it as live.
Headline prize is a near-impossible perfect-table jackpot, shared; typical prizes £100-£500.
UK/Ireland only - not available to a US entrant.
Publisher is a betting-tipster affiliate site.
